# C-3 · Security Categorization Review and Approval

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Step | C Categorize (system level) |
| Phases | PH-MSA (primary), PH-TMRR |
| Depends on | C-2 |
| Inputs | ART-CAT, EXT-ORG-POLICY |
| Outputs | ART-CAT (updates), ART-REG (updates) |
| Writes facts | categorization.approved |
| Minimum interviews | 1 |
| RACI | R: PER-AODR, PER-PRIV · A: PER-AO · C: PER-RE, PER-CIO, PER-CISO · I: PER-PM, PER-ISSM · PER-PRIV only when the system processes PII |
| Persona cards | [PER-AODR](../../personas/PER-AODR.md), [PER-PRIV](../../personas/PER-PRIV.md), [PER-AO](../../personas/PER-AO.md), [PER-RE](../../personas/PER-RE.md), [PER-CIO](../../personas/PER-CIO.md), [PER-CISO](../../personas/PER-CISO.md) |

Purpose: Review the security categorization and have the AO (or AODR) approve it, with SAOP (or designee) approval as well when the system processes PII; approval is due by Milestone A.
<!-- END rmf:header -->
<!-- rmf:body authored -->

## Steps

1. **Entry check.** `facts.yaml` has `categorization` with `set_by_task: C-2`, and
   `artifacts/ART-CAT.md` exists.
2. **Read the inputs** in `## Inputs`.
3. **Review interview with PER-AODR** (`## Interviews`). Role-play the AODR as a skeptical
   reviewer: they check that every information type has an owner's value, that each system
   value is the high-water mark, that no value was lowered for cost, and that each overlay
   decision has a reason. Record their questions and findings. Why: C-3 exists so that a
   senior official, not the system team, confirms the categorization (CNSSI 1253 §3.1.2,
   DoDI 8510.01 Table 2).
4. **If the review finds a defect:** correct ART-CAT and `facts.yaml#categorization` the way
   C-2 would (same rules), append a CORRECTION entry to the journal, and repeat step 3. Do
   not set `approved` while a finding is open.
5. **Approval interview with the approver.** The AO or the AODR approves (DoDI 8510.01
   Table 2 names "AO or AODR"). Ask the approver for an explicit approval of the
   categorization shown in the facts block. In hybrid mode with a named human for that
   persona, the human must answer; never simulate it (`_shared/hybrid-mode.md` step 4).
6. **Write the approval fact.** Rewrite `facts.yaml` whole, keeping every field, and add
   `approved` inside `categorization`:

   ```yaml
   categorization:
     # c, i, a, overlays, method, set_by_task: C-2 and sources stay exactly as C-2 wrote them
     approved:
       value: true
       approved_by: PER-AODR
       set_by_task: C-3
       sources: [INT-009.A2]
   ```

   `approved_by` is the persona who approved (`PER-AO` or `PER-AODR`). Leave every C-2
   field unchanged; `set_by_task` of `categorization` itself stays `C-2`. Why: each fact has
   one writer; C-3 writes only `categorization.approved`.
7. **Update `artifacts/ART-CAT.md`.** Append `C-3` to `touched_by`, add the approval answer
   to `sources`, and add a `## Review and approval` section: who reviewed, what they
   checked, findings and their resolution, and who approved, each traced.
8. **Build and check.** `uv run rmf build <run>`, then `uv run rmf check <run> --task C-3`,
   until 0 errors. FACTS-001 now applies in full: every fact written by P-11, C-1, C-2 and
   C-3 must be present with its `set_by_task`.
9. **Journal** a DECISION for the approval, then a CHECKPOINT.

## Interviews

| Persona | Why | Question focus |
|---|---|---|
| PER-AODR | responsible (R); reviews for the AO | owner input per information type, high-water mark, no lowering for cost, overlay reasons, consistency with the risk assessment |
| PER-AO | accountable (A); may approve personally | approval of the categorization, any condition on it |

At least 1 interview. Use one interview with PER-AODR when the AODR both reviews and
approves; add a PER-AO interview when the AO approves.

## Inputs

- `artifacts/ART-CAT.md`
- `facts.yaml` (the `categorization` block)
- `artifacts/ART-INFOTYPES.md`, `artifacts/data/infotypes.yaml` (to check the table)
- Reference: CNSSI1253 §3.1.2

## Outputs

| File | Front-matter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `artifacts/ART-CAT.md` | `touched_by: [C-2, C-3]` | updated: review and approval section |
| `facts.yaml` | — | `categorization.approved` only |

## Facts

| Field | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `categorization.approved` | `{value: true, approved_by: PER-AO or PER-AODR, set_by_task: C-3}` | the approver's answer |

## Done when

- `facts.yaml#categorization.approved` has `value: true`, `approved_by` and
  `set_by_task: C-3`.
- ART-CAT lists C-3 in `touched_by` and records the review and approval.
- `uv run rmf check <run> --task C-3` reports 0 errors.

## Journal and lessons

- DECISION: `## <time> · DECISION · task C-3 · by: PER-AODR (simulated, INT-###.A#)`.
- CORRECTION (if step 4 ran): `## <time> · CORRECTION · artifact ART-CAT · lesson: ...`.
  A categorization defect a reviewer catches is worth a lesson when C-2's procedure allowed
  it.
- CHECKPOINT: `## <time> · CHECKPOINT · task C-3`.
